title: antidesma pyrifolium
intro: Antidesma pyrifolium, commonly known as the Philippine pear or Panakén, is a plant species in the family Phyllanthaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, which include lowering blood pressure, reducing inflammation, and aiding in digestion. The therapeutic actions of Antidesma pyrifolium include its antioxidant, anti-diabetic, and anti-inflammatory properties, which make it a potential treatment for various diseases. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
